channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Elon Musk was half-right in his comment last week about SoftBank back-pedaling on a gas-turbine order
item.description: Elon Musk in a social-media post last week said that SoftBank “defaulted” on a gas-turbine order. The truth, revealed Tuesday in the Japanese’s investment company’s second-quarter earnings, wasn’t far off.

item.title: SoftBank logs $7 billion loss after U.S. data center costs swell
item.description: Analysts on average expected a profit of more than $800 million.

item.title: Japan to use COP31 to showcase environmental technologies
item.description: A key goal of the conference is to increase the world's electrification to 35% by 2035.

item.title: Sakana AI may go public in 2027
item.description: Press reports say that the company is considering the Tokyo Stock Exchange or Nasdaq or a dual listing on both.

item.title: Japan to call for limiting children’s exposure to social media
item.description: A government draft says schools should help children develop their judgment so that they can use social media appropriately.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
